_comment: Binary pothole benchmark labels. Images are NOT committed: see eval/README.md. Owner-verified cases include seven manual pothole photos and the two speed-breaker intervals identified by the tester as negatives; the opening traffic-calming interval is independently reviewed. The 28 Aug construction-road clips contain two definite pothole events (A and mid), one ambiguous broad patch (B) labelled negative under the strict false-positive policy, and an all-negative second segment. Those drive-video labels were independently frame-reviewed, not owner-verified. Other negatives remain assistant-judged and UNVERIFIED; disputed and unlabelled images are excluded from rates. This small set is still not a release gate.
